Founder & CEO of GrowHaz

Om Uikey

Software developer, cybersecurity researcher and AI builder focused on practical technology.

Om Uikey is the founder and CEO of GrowHaz. He builds practical technology to solve real-world problems, including blockchain document verification and provenance, cybersecurity research into adaptive firewalls, and AI automation where it is useful.

What Om Uikey works on

  • Blockchain document verification: document integrity, provenance and traceable process records.
  • Cybersecurity: website security assessment, evidence-based findings and research into adaptive firewall systems.
  • AI and automation: applying AI and workflow automation where they solve a practical problem.

At GrowHaz, Om works across software engineering, cybersecurity, blockchain and automation to build useful systems for businesses and people.
